title: alisma plantago-aquatica var. arcuatum
intro: Alisma plantago-aquatica var. arcuatum, commonly known as  water plantain or Chinese water plantain, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Alismataceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat a range of health conditions, including edema, dysuria, and diarrhea, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving kidney function. The plant's therapeutic actions include diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its ability to relieve symptoms of urinary disorders and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of A. plantago-aquatica var. arcuatum include iridoid glycosides, alkaloids, and polyphenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
